# GD Level Tools

> Independent fan-made tools and guides for Geometry Dash. Find levels by difficulty, pick your first demon, plan your demon progression, look up vault codes, and follow step-by-step fix and mod guides. Not affiliated with RobTop Games.

All content is original, written by fans for fans. Geometry Dash and all related names belong to RobTop Games.

## Tools

- [Level Finder](https://geometrydashlevel.com/level-finder/): Filter levels by difficulty, demon tier, skill, length, and platform. The main discovery tool.
- [Demon List](https://geometrydashlevel.com/demon-list/): All demons grouped by tier (Easy → Extreme), with Pointercrate reference.
- [First Demon Picker](https://geometrydashlevel.com/first-demon-picker/): Interactive questionnaire that recommends a personalized first demon based on your skills and platform.
- [Demon Progression Planner](https://geometrydashlevel.com/demon-progression/): Enter your current demon count and get a stage-based roadmap of which demons to play next.
- [Vault Codes](https://geometrydashlevel.com/vault-codes/): Searchable list of in-game secret codes for The Vault, Vault of Secrets, Chamber of Time, and Wraith Vault.
- [Submit a Level](https://geometrydashlevel.com/submit-level/): Community level submission form.

## Guides

In-depth how-to guides organized by category: rewards, mods, fixes, skills, demons, and general.

### Rewards Guides

- [How to Get Diamonds in Geometry Dash](https://geometrydashlevel.com/guides/diamonds/): You can get diamonds by completing daily quests, daily levels, weekly demons, opening chests, and completing gauntlets.
- [How to Get Gold Keys in Geometry Dash](https://geometrydashlevel.com/guides/gold-keys/): Gold keys can be obtained from Demon Event levels, chests (including event and Wraith chests), and specific vault codes.
- [How to Get Demon Keys in Geometry Dash](https://geometrydashlevel.com/guides/demon-keys/): Demon Keys are earned by completing Demon-difficulty levels, opening Demon chests, and through specific vault codes.
- [How to Get User Coins in Geometry Dash](https://geometrydashlevel.com/guides/user-coins/): User coins are collected inside user-created levels. Silver coins are verified by RobTop, while bronze coins are unverified.
- [How to Get the Master Emblem in Geometry Dash](https://geometrydashlevel.com/guides/master-emblem/): The Master Emblem costs 700 Diamonds and 1000 Mana Orbs, purchased from the shop after completing The Challenge. It unlocks the Chamber o...
